explanation: A class template declaration in C++ defines a blueprint for creating classes parameterized by types. It allows the programmer to write generic, reusable class definitions that can operate with any data type specified at instantiation time. This feature is fundamental for generic programming, enabling code flexibility, type safety, and compile-time polymorphism, especially within the Standard Template Library (STL) and modern C++ idioms.
keywords: Class Template, Template Class, C++ Templates, Generic Programming
